description: Reviews API: List Capterra reviews. Capterra reviews of a software product (the shared pool of Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice, every language) as `Review` objects, with pros, cons, sub-ratings, likelihood to recommend and the reviewer's role, industry and company size (never the name). `sort`, `language` and one `stars` value are applied by Capterra; several stars, `since` and `until` on each page. Pages hold 5 reviews (the first) then 25. A page that returns nothing only because of the filters, with `has_more` true, is free. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 25, one page of the source)

name: reviews_capterra_product_reviews
title: List Capterra reviews
